data.set-maintenance.sh:
#!/bin/bash

set -ex

# We exit successfully because we do not want to fail the upgrade on maintenance mode.
trap "echo 'Timeout reached. Exiting successfully'; exit 0" SIGTERM

echo "Applying update to configmap to set router mode"

kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nightly-suse-observability-router-automatic
  namespace: observability
data:
  listeners.yaml: |-
    resources:
    - "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.listener.v3.Listener
      name: listener_0
      address:
        socket_address:
          protocol: TCP
          address: 0.0.0.0
          port_value: 8080
      filter_chains:
      - filters:
        - name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
          typed_config:
            "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.http_connection_manager.v3.HttpConnectionManager
            access_log:
            - name: envoy.access_loggers.stdout
              typed_config:
                "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.access_loggers.stream.v3.StdoutAccessLog
              filter:
                status_code_filter:
                  comparison:
                    op: GE
                    value:
                      default_value: 400
                      runtime_key: log_ge_response_status_code
            codec_type: AUTO
            stat_prefix: ingress_http
            upgrade_configs:
            - upgrade_type: websocket
            route_config:
              name: local_route
              virtual_hosts:
              - name: backend
                domains:
                - "*"
                routes:
                - match:
                    prefix: "/api"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "nightly-suse-observability-api-main"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/loginCallback"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "nightly-suse-observability-api-main"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/loginInfo"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "nightly-suse-observability-api-main"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/logout"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "nightly-suse-observability-api-main"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/ssoLogin"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "nightly-suse-observability-api-main"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/prometheus/api/v1/"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "nightly-suse-observability-api-main"
                    prefix_rewrite: "/api/metrics/"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/stsAgent/otel/"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "suse-observability-otel-collector"
                    prefix_rewrite: "/"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/receiver/stsAgent/otel/"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "suse-observability-otel-collector"
                    prefix_rewrite: "/"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/stsAgent"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "nightly-suse-observability-receiver"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/receiver/"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "nightly-suse-observability-receiver"
                    prefix_rewrite: "/"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/mcp"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "suse-observability-mcp"
                - match:
                    prefix: "/"
                  route:
                    timeout: 0s
                    cluster: "suse-observability-ui"
                  response_headers_to_add:
                    - header:
                        key: "X-Frame-Options"
                        value: "DENY"
                      append_action: APPEND_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD
            http_filters:
            - name: envoy.filters.http.router
              typed_config:
                "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.router.v3.Router
  clusters.yaml: |-
    resources:
    - "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster
      name: "nightly-suse-observability-api-main"
      type: STRICT_DNS
      lb_policy: LEAST_REQUEST
      typed_extension_protocol_options:
        envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions:
          "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions
          explicit_http_config:
            http_protocol_options: {}
      connect_timeout: 2s
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: "nightly-suse-observability-api-main"
        endpoints:
    - "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster
      name: "nightly-suse-observability-receiver"
      type: STRICT_DNS
      lb_policy: LEAST_REQUEST
      connect_timeout: 2s
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: "nightly-suse-observability-api-receiver"
        endpoints:
        - lb_endpoints:
          - endpoint:
              address:
                socket_address:
                  address: "nightly-suse-observability-receiver"
                  port_value: 7077
    - "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster
      name: "suse-observability-otel-collector"
      type: STRICT_DNS
      lb_policy: LEAST_REQUEST
      connect_timeout: 2s
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: "suse-observability-otel-collector"
        endpoints:
        - lb_endpoints:
          - endpoint:
              address:
                socket_address:
                  address: "suse-observability-otel-collector"
                  port_value: 4318
    - "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster
      name: "suse-observability-ui"
      type: STRICT_DNS
      lb_policy: LEAST_REQUEST
      typed_extension_protocol_options:
        envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions:
          "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions
          explicit_http_config:
            http_protocol_options: {}
      connect_timeout: 2s
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: "nightly-suse-observability-api-ui"
        endpoints:
        - lb_endpoints:
          - endpoint:
              address:
                socket_address:
                  address: "suse-observability-ui"
                  port_value: 8080
    - "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.cluster.v3.Cluster
      name: "suse-observability-mcp"
      type: STRICT_DNS
      lb_policy: LEAST_REQUEST
      typed_extension_protocol_options:
        envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions:
          "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.upstreams.http.v3.HttpProtocolOptions
          explicit_http_config:
            http_protocol_options: {}
      connect_timeout: 2s
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: "suse-observability-mcp"
        endpoints:
        - lb_endpoints:
          - endpoint:
              address:
                socket_address:
                  address: "suse-observability-mcp"
                  port_value: 8080
EOF

# We proactively restart the deployment when it is updated. This is strictly speaking not necessary because the content changes will be
# picked up automatically, however:
# - Updating the FS based on a config map can 30 seconds, so a long time
# - We would like to actively reset connections, to make all clients go in to maintenance
# - After the restart we are sure the configmap is applied.
# shellcheck disable=SC2140
if kubectl get deployment "nightly-suse-observability-router" -n "observability"; then
  echo "Restarting router"
  kubectl rollout restart "deployment/nightly-suse-observability-router" -n "observability"

  echo "Waiting for rollout to complete..."
  while ! kubectl rollout status "deployment/nightly-suse-observability-router" -n "observability"; do
    echo "."
    if ! kubectl get deployment "nightly-suse-observability-router" -n "observability"; then
      echo "Deployment went away, exiting"
      exit 0
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
else
  echo "Deployment not yet found, continuing."
fi

# We opted to not http-based dynamic checking of the 503. This is because:
# when switching from 'active' to 'automatic' mode, the pre-hook will run before the deployment upgrade, so
# the 'router-automatic' configmap will not have been picked up.
#
# A second reason is we do not want to block the pre-hook based on fixes that may be ni the main chart, otherwise we get stuck
# Leaving here for reference
#
#echo "Waiting for router mode to be applied"
#
#while [[ "$(curl -I nightly-suse-observability-router:8080/api | head -n 1 | cut -d ' ' -f 2)" != "503" ]]; do
#  echo -n "."
#  sleep 1
#done

echo "Router mode enabled"
